title: Abel's offering and Christ's offering (Genesis 4:4; Ephesians 5:2)
summary: Genesis 4:4 (Abel brings the firstborn of his flock and the LORD has regard for his offering) is set above Ephesians 5:2, where Christ gave Himself for us as an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling aroma.

text.text: 4 And Abel, he also brought an offering, from the firstborn of his flock and from their fat portions. And the LORD had regard for Abel and his offering;
2 And walk in love, as Christ also has loved us and given Himself for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling aroma.
